references.text: Here we see the same group of religious leaders (chief priests and Pharisees) sending servants to arrest Jesus, but the servants return empty-handed in 7:45.
The servants answer the question about why they did not bring Jesus with them by saying that never has any man spoken like this man.
A similar situation arises later when the high priest sends a crowd of servants and officers to arrest Jesus, but the servants return without having completed their mission.
